extracted.name: Pomegranate salad with feta and beetroot
extracted.description: Enjoy something lighter for lunch with this bright salad. It's low-calorie and full of flavour thanks to mint, parsley, cinnamon and cumin
ingredient_lines: 2 cooked beetroot cut into thin wedges
½ romaine lettuce torn into bite-sized pieces
instruction_lines: Whisk the oil, pomegranate molasses, cinnamon, cumin seeds and lemon juice together in a bowl. Add 1 tbsp water to loosen, and season.
Toss in the herbs, beetroot, feta, rocket and lettuce, and toss to coat in the dressing. Sprinkle over the pomegranate seeds to serve.
